changelog:
Initial release of the image-to-perler-bead skill

- Converts any photo into a perler bead (Hama 熨斗豆) pattern with printable HTML grid, PNG preview, and color-coded material list.
- Automatically detects user intent (e.g. "照片转拼豆", "perler bead pattern") and guides parameter selection (width, mode, dither, etc).
- Provides tailored suggestions for common project sizes, color adjustments, and optimal settings.
- Includes detailed reference guides for bead color mapping, crafting instructions, and advanced/batch use.
- Integrates with user’s Python venv and auto-prompts to install dependencies if missing.
- Handles edge cases and gives tips for best pattern results and material estimation.
